It makes me wonder why I'm even still here. Not because I want to live,
feedback_history.therapist_response:
I hear that—how terrifying it is to carry these thoughts alone, especially when someone you care about can’t meet you in the pain. The fear of death isn’t just about ending, but about the unbearable weight of continuing through all those broken moments again and again. And it’s completely okay to feel afraid of that fear. You don’t have to explain it or make it “go away” right now.  

Would it be helpful to talk about what “carrying on” feels like for you—what would it look like if you could just rest, without having to fix anything, without having to prove anything to anyone? Just for a moment, what would that feel like?
